palette.hint: Drag a stage onto a pipeline.

inspector.hint: Select a watch, a pipeline or a stage to edit it.
inspector.name: Name

tree.path: Path of a new file or folder
tree.hint: To make a folder an exception, add a folder configuration with the button beside it.

output.empty: Trigger the watch to see where each file goes.

filter.name: Filter
filter.about: Lets files through by extension or name pattern; first in a pipeline it claims files, later it drops them.

ext.name: Extensions
ext.about: Extensions, any case, without the dot.

glob.name: Name pattern
glob.about: A file name pattern; with ext, both must match.

invert.name: Invert
invert.about: Inverts the result, to drop what matches.

number.name: Number
number.about: Takes one number out of a field, such as the episode or season.

from.name: Source field
from.about: The field to look in; name by default.

nth.name: Which one
nth.about: Which candidate to take; negative counts from the end.

prefix.name: Prefix
prefix.about: Only the number right after this word, such as Season.

exclude.name: Excluded fields
exclude.about: Skips the current values of these fields, so a season is not taken for an episode.

regex.name: Regex
regex.about: Captures or rewrites a field with a regular expression, for what the built-in stages cannot do.

pattern.name: Regular expression
pattern.about: The regular expression; named groups become fields.

from.name: Source field
from.about: The field to match; name by default.

into.name: Target field
into.about: Writes the whole match into this field.

replace.name: Rewrite to
replace.about: Rewrites the match instead of capturing it.

set.name: Set values
set.about: Sets fixed values, replacing what the fields held.

default.name: Default values
default.about: Fills fixed values only into fields still unset; place it after the captures.

replace.name: Replace
replace.about: Replaces literal text in a field.

with.name: Replace with
with.about: The text to put in its place.

field.name: Field
field.about: The field to rewrite; name by default.

case.name: Case
case.about: Changes the case of a field.

field.name: Field
field.about: The field to rewrite; name by default.

strip.name: Strip tags
strip.about: Removes bracketed tags and tidies the spaces left.

groups.name: Brackets
groups.about: The brackets to remove; only [] by default.

field.name: Field
field.about: The field to rewrite; name by default.

format.name: Format name
format.about: Builds the file name from a template; the extension is added at the end.

value.name: Name template
value.about: The name template, such as {show} s{season:02}e{episode:02}.

folder.name: Add folders
folder.about: Adds folders under the target from a template.

to.name: Lift to
to.about: A folder name pattern; lifts to the nearest folder that matches.

value.name: Levels up
value.about: How many levels to move up.

next.name: Next number
next.about: For a field still unset, takes the highest value among the files already at the target, plus one.

like.name: Match template
like.about: The template existing names are matched by; the into field is the part counted.

rank.name: Rank
rank.about: Orders and numbers the files of a group, such as several subtitles.

into.name: Target field
into.about: The field to write the number into.

by.name: Group by
by.about: The fields files are grouped by.

prefer.name: Prefer
prefer.about: Files whose original name holds these come first.

take.name: Take fields
take.about: Copies fields to a subtitle from the video whose name it starts with.

from.name: Source pipeline
from.about: The pipeline to take from; all earlier ones by default.

move.name: Move
move.about: Moves the file to its planned path, never overwriting a file.

on_conflict.name: On a clash
on_conflict.about: On a clash, reject refuses; suffix retries once with a suffix.

suffix.name: Suffix
suffix.about: The suffix added on a clash; _v2 by default.

cleanup.name: Clean up
cleanup.about: Removes folders the move emptied, only inside the unit.

keep.name: Folders to keep
keep.about: Folders matching these patterns are kept.
